Service area

Bay Area service. Remote support beyond.

In person and remotely

We provide in-person and remote accessibility and assistive technology services in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Vallejo, and Marin County.

Remote services are also available to clients beyond the Bay Area and outside California.
